text:
Maya: Heads-up—the big tea tin is empty again. Left a note but someone keeps making English Breakfast disappear. :tea:
Denise: I swear I haven't touched the tin. I brought a box of peppermint this morning. :herb:
Frank: Not me either. I did, however, make a cold brew that is in the labeled mason jar "FRANK". Help yourselves. :coffee:
Maya: @Frank bless. Is the microwave still making that weird squeal? It got loud just now when I zapped soup.
Luke: That's the turntable motor. Did a quick fix with a zip tie last week; probably wobbled loose. I'll put it on my evening repair list.
Allison: Can someone add "tea audit" to the kitchen checklist? 2-person rotation for restock? I can do Wed & Sat pickups.
Denise: I'd volunteer but I have a dentist on Wed. Happy to swap Sat.
kitchen-bot: automatic reminder scheduled: "Kitchen restock rotation — Allison (Wed), Luke (Sat)" at 08:00 tomorrow.
Maya: Also, microwave etiquette reminder: cover your bowl (no soup geysers). Let's keep the lid traffic light clean.
Frank: Note: if you take the big tea tin, replace it with an empty labeled jar so we know to restock. Otherwise it disappears into the void.
Luke: I'll bring extra microwave-safe lids on Friday. :thumbsup:
Maya: Cool. Whoever is doing restock this week — can you grab decaf cold brew concentrate? people love it for afternoons.
Denise: On it. I'll buy and charge to #kitchen-budget. ETA Friday.
Maya: :tada: Thanks y'all — less tea mystery, more biscuits.
